{{Quote|This is the shuttle ''Arkanoid''. Requesting permission to dock.''"<br />"''Transmit authorization codes, ''Arkanoid''.|Han Solo and an Imperial stationed on Zoma station|<ref name="Renegade" />}}
The '''''Arkanoid''''' was a [[Zeta-class long-range shuttle|''Zeta''-class long-range shuttle]]<ref name="Command Decision" /> in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Renegade" />

Scavenged by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[P'laang Ri]] from the Empire, the ''Zeta''-class [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was borrowed by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to infiltrate and steal an Imperial shipment from [[Zoma Station]]. Having left [[Gender/Legends|his]] personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] with the indebted Ri on [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]] for safekeeping, Han Solo, accompanied by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and fellow Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Avik Lore]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ''Arkanoid'' to Zoma Station.<ref name="Renegade" />

As it departed from Siskeen, the ''Zeta''-class [[Transport/Legends|shuttle]]&mdash;noted by Solo to be far smaller than the ''Millennium Falcon''&mdash;had its hydraulics conduit burst at the beginning of the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] voyage to Zoma Station, leading to a cabin filled with what Solo thought was the unpleasant scent of "wet Wookiee fur."<ref name="Renegade" />

Eager to leave the Imperial shuttle, Han Solo beamed a transmission via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to Zoma Station upon the ''Arkanoid''{{'s}} return to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], attempting to secure permission to board with authorization codes obtained by Avik Lore on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] prior. Without any Imperial entanglements, the ''Arkanoid'' was allowed to land on the station as the latter's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] activated and led the ''Zeta''-class into its [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]].<ref name="Renegade" />

Ultimately, Han Solo's mission was a success; the smuggler and his [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] Chewbacca left Zoma Station and later retrieved the ''Millennium Falcon'' from P'laang Ri.<ref name="Renegade" />
